### Aesthetics and Creative Practice

[aestheticsAndCreativePractice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/aestheticsAndCreativePractice/aestheticsAndCreativePractice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artistic experience, imagination, revision and ethical decisions cross individual media. This domain avoids prescribing a universal theory of beauty or one compulsory creative workflow.

**User-friendly description (en):** Explore how art affects us, communicates meaning and grows through creative choices.

### Art History and Cultures

Groups: 14 · Skills: 59

[artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artworks and artistic practices develop within particular communities, historical debates, patrons and material technologies. Study of art history distinguishes movements and named traditions through their own works and contexts rather than treating an entire continent or historical era as a single skill. This domain examines art-historical interpretation, not general political chronology.

**User-friendly description (en):** Explore how works of art reflect particular places, communities, periods and artistic debates.
